1: // WebSocket transport: connects to the server's `/ws`, applies each received
2: // PLPL batch to the DOM renderer, negotiates the protocol version, and reports
3: // raw-input events back. Reconnect/backoff live here; session-resync and
4: // frameCount gap handling are P3 (the module seam is the `onBatch` hook).
5: 
6: import type { Batch } from "./plpl";
7: import { ProtocolError, parseBatch } from "./plpl";
8: import { applyBatch, type DomRenderer } from "./apply";
9: import { encodeResync } from "./events";
10: import { VERSION } from "./constants";
11: import { log } from "./log";
12: import { describeBatch, describeBatchDetail } from "./describe";
13: 
14: export type TransportStatus = "connecting" | "open" | "reconnecting";
15: 
16: export interface TransportOptions {
17:   /** WebSocket URL, e.g. `ws://host/ws`. */
18:   url: string;
19:   /** The retained-node registry deltas are applied to. */
20:   renderer: DomRenderer;
21:   /** Invoked after a batch is successfully applied (P3: resync/frameCount hooks). */
22:   onBatch?: (batch: Batch) => void;
23:   onStatus?: (status: TransportStatus) => void;
24:   /**
25:    * Invoked on every socket open (first connect and reconnect), before any RESYNC —
26:    * the DOM client sends its `META::ENVIRONMENT` (viewport + route) here as the first
27:    * message so the server session seeds from it.
28:    */
29:   onOpen?: (transport: Transport) => void;
30:   /** Injectable socket factory (tests). */
31:   createSocket?: (url: string) => WebSocket;
32: }
33: 
34: const BASE_DELAY_MS = 500;
35: const MAX_DELAY_MS = 30000;
36: const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 30;
37: 
38: // Numeric readyState (the WebSocket global may be absent in test environments).
39: const WS_OPEN = 1;
40: 
41: export class Transport {
42:   private ws: WebSocket | null = null;
43:   private attempt = 0;
44:   private stopped = false;
45:   private readonly options: TransportOptions;
46: 
47:   constructor(options: TransportOptions) {
48:     this.options = options;
49:   }
50: 
51:   /** Connect and stay connected (auto-reconnect with exponential backoff). */
52:   start(): void {
53:     this.stopped = false;
54:     this.connect();
55:   }
56: 
57:   /** Permanently close the socket and cancel reconnects. */
58:   stop(): void {
59:     this.stopped = true;
60:     if (this.ws) {
61:       this.ws.onclose = null;
62:       this.ws.close();
63:       this.ws = null;
64:     }
65:   }
66: 
67:   get open(): boolean {
68:     return this.ws !== null && this.ws.readyState === WS_OPEN;
69:   }
70: 
71:   send(bytes: Uint8Array): void {
72:     if (!this.open) {
73:       return;
74:     }
75:     // Best-effort description (never drops the bytes, even if undecodable).
76:     try {
77:       const batch = parseBatch(bytes);
78:       log.info("ws", "→ send", describeBatch(batch));
79:       log.debug("ws", "→ send detail", describeBatchDetail(batch));
80:     } catch {
81:       log.info("ws", "→ send", bytes.length, "bytes");
82:     }
83:     this.ws!.send(bytes);
84:   }
85: 
86:   private connect(): void {
87:     log.debug("ws", "connecting", this.options.url);
88:     const ws = this.options.createSocket
89:       ? this.options.createSocket(this.options.url)
90:       : new WebSocket(this.options.url);
91:     this.ws = ws;
92:     ws.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
93:     ws.onopen = () => {
94:       // A reconnect means the client missed deltas while disconnected: request a
95:       // full snapshot (META::RESYNC). The first connect never does — the client
96:       // already has the whole UI from the SSR HTML. On EVERY open (before any
97:       // resync) the client sends its environment (viewport + route).
98:       const reconnected = this.attempt > 0;
99:       this.attempt = 0;
100:       log.info("ws", reconnected ? "connected (reconnect)" : "connected");
101:       this.options.onStatus?.("open");
102:       this.options.onOpen?.(this);
103:       if (reconnected) {
104:         log.debug("ws", "requesting RESYNC (missed deltas while disconnected)");
105:         this.send(encodeResync());
106:       }
107:     };
108:     ws.onmessage = (event) => this.handleMessage(event.data);
109:     ws.onerror = () => {
110:       log.error("ws", "socket error");
111:       // onclose always follows; nothing to do here.
112:     };
113:     ws.onclose = () => {
114:       this.ws = null;
115:       if (this.stopped) {
116:         log.debug("ws", "closed (stopped)");
117:         return;
118:       }
119:       log.info("ws", "closed — reconnecting (attempt", this.attempt + 1 + ")");
120:       this.options.onStatus?.("reconnecting");
121:       this.scheduleReconnect();
122:     };
123:   }
124: 
125:   private scheduleReconnect(): void {
126:     if (this.attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
127:       return;
128:     }
129:     const delay = Math.min(BASE_DELAY_MS * 2 ** this.attempt, MAX_DELAY_MS);
130:     this.attempt++;
131:     setTimeout(() => this.connect(), delay);
132:   }
133: 
134:   private handleMessage(data: unknown): void {
135:     let bytes: Uint8Array;
136:     if (data instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
137:       bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
138:     } else if (data instanceof Blob) {
139:       void data.arrayBuffer().then((buffer) => this.handleMessage(buffer));
140:       return;
141:     } else {
142:       bytes = new Uint8Array(0);
143:     }
144:     let batch: Batch;
145:     try {
146:       batch = parseBatch(bytes);
147:     } catch (err) {
148:       if (err instanceof ProtocolError) {
149:         log.error("ws", "rejected batch:", err.message);
150:         return;
151:       }
152:       throw err;
153:     }
154:     log.info("ws", "← recv", describeBatch(batch));
155:     log.debug("ws", "← recv detail", describeBatchDetail(batch));
156:     if (batch.version !== VERSION) {
157:       log.warn("ws", `protocol version ${batch.version} != ${VERSION}; reloading`);
158:       location.reload();
159:       return;
160:     }
161:     try {
162:       applyBatch(batch, this.options.renderer);
163:     } catch (err) {
164:       if (err instanceof ProtocolError) {
165:         log.error("ws", "rejected delta:", err.message);
166:         return;
167:       }
168:       throw err;
169:     }
170:     this.options.onBatch?.(batch);
171:   }
172: }

55:  * Elements that declare no listeners are skipped, so non-listening children never
56:  * steal an event from a listening ancestor.
57:  */

59:   let el: Element | null = target;
60:   while (el && el !== document.body) {
61:     if (el.hasAttribute("data-pathland-id")) {
62:       const raw = el.getAttribute("data-event-listeners");
